overview.description: The Amplify Top 10 Quantum ETF (XQBT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund targets 10 companies from around the world involved in quantum hardware and systems. The actively managed fund directly invests in equity securities or through derivatives that provide exposure to companies from a reference index that has momentum, revenue and thematic considerations. XQBT was launched on Aug 18, 2026 and is issued by Amplify Investments.
